summary: The RptDestPlcSchedule module is responsible for handling the display, input, and validation of scheduling reports within the HSPnet application. It consists of various UI controls, such as labels, radio buttons, textboxes, and link buttons, which are used to select and customize reports. The module also includes validator controls and custom JavaScript to ensure proper data input and processing.
purpose: The primary purpose of the RptDestPlcSchedule module is to facilitate the creation and management of destination placement schedule reports, allowing for options to include accepted, confirmed, or pending requests, and manage report output formats such as individual PDFs.

workflows.name: Report Generation
steps: Load page with dropdown data binding if not a postback.
Register client-side JavaScript variables upon pre-render.
Check and set visibility of individual PDF option based on destination access list.
Determine IncludeOption based on radio button selection.
Fetch destination list from user session.
Display error if no destinations selected or if too many items are selected.
Create and generate report job based on selected options.

business_rules: Must select at least one destination to generate a report.
Cannot exceed the maximum number of include items for a report job.
conditions: If radConfirmedRequests is checked, IncludeOption is set to 0.
If radAcceptedConfirmed is checked, IncludeOption is set to 1.
If radPendRedirAcceptedConfirmed is checked, IncludeOption is set to 2.
If destination list is empty, display error message.
If destination list exceeds maximum, display error message.
system_behavior: JavaScript declarations are created and registered based on control IDs.
User session determines if the report command can be run.
Register or display client-side startup scripts based on postback status.
dependencies: User session data, including destination list and support contact information.
JavaScript and Ajax toolkit for date handling.
exceptions: Unable to generate report when monitoring another user.
Error messages for no or excessive selected destinations.
